text: I build SavannaTime, a screen-time tracker. It is very good at telling me I spent five hours in VS Code. It has never once made me stand up.
Savanna Grass reads my day from SavannaTime, and turns it into grass debt. Ten minutes outside for every hour on screens. Distracting time counts one and a half times.
Then Gemma 3, one B, an open-weight model running right here on the device, writes me a quest from the shape of my day.
No signal? It still works. My screen time never leaves the device for the AI. No API key, no vendor, and no bill per walk.
Tap go, and the app gets boring on purpose. Phone in pocket. Eyes up.
When I'm back, the break is logged to SavannaTime, next to my screen time, and the debt goes down.
Savanna Grass. Open source, on-device, and built to get you outside.
